review_candidates.title: Network/Systems Administrator
review_candidates.description: Unusual Machines is a U.S.-based drone and drone parts company focused on the small and First-Person View (FPV) segments of the drone market. Our brands - Rotor Riot and Fat Shark - are two of the most respected names in FPV and have helped shape the industry through e-commerce, product development, and a deep connection with the pilot community. We’re expanding into enterprise and defense - bringing our obsessive attention to performance, design, and U.S.-based manufacturing into high-stakes environments like search and rescue and military innovation. With several of our products already approved by the Defense Innovation Unit, we’re solving procurement issues for customers who demand speed, agility, and compliance. If you love working at the intersection of community, content, and cutting-edge technology, you’ll feel right at home here. You in This Role The Network / Systems Administrator is an individual-contributor role within a lean IT department of three. You will own the day-to-day administration, monitoring, and troubleshooting of Unusual Machines' enterprise network and systems infrastructure across all seven sites. Working directly with the Director of IT, you will be a primary subject matter expert for firewall, switching, wireless, identity, cloud, and server infrastructure, while supporting compliance obligations and contributing to ongoing strategic IT buildout initiatives. This role is ideal for a technically deep, self-directed administrator who thrives in a fast-moving environment, takes genuine ownership of infrastructure, and understands the discipline required in regulated industries. What You'll Do Administer and maintain the enterprise firewall environment, including centralized policy management, NAT, zone architecture, and application-aware filtering rules Manage secure remote access and zero-trust network access (ZTNA) policy enforcement for a distributed workforce Operate and maintain enterprise switching infrastructure across all sites, including VLANs, trunking, spanning tree, QoS, port security, and configuration management Administer enterprise wireless access points and branch failover connectivity across all locations via centralized cloud management Maintain enterprise WAN connectivity across all seven sites; coordinate with carriers on circuit issues and escalations Manage dedicated storage networking with performance-optimized configuration for enterprise storage workloads Support DNS operations for the company's domain infrastructure Systems & Cloud Infrastructure Administer the Microsoft 365 tenant, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, and OneDrive Manage enterprise identity infrastructure: Conditional Access policy authoring and tuning, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), Identity Protection risk policies, and automated provisioning integrations Operate endpoint management tooling for policy management, compliance baselines, zero-touch device provisioning, and application deployment Administer Windows Server infrastructure including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, and file services Manage NAS/storage infrastructure Operate and maintain backup and disaster recovery processes; ensure recovery objectives are met and tested ITSM & Operations Operate within the enterprise ITSM platform: own infrastructure-tier tickets, contribute to CMDB asset accuracy, document changes per change management process Maintain network and systems documentation to a professional standard, including configuration baselines, topology diagrams, runbooks, and change records Participate in on-call rotation and respond to after-hours infrastructure incidents as needed across a multi-site footprint Provide assistance and escalation support to Desktop Helpdesk staff for network, identity, and server-related issues What You'll Bring 5+ years of hands-on experience in a network/systems administration role in an enterprise environment Enterprise firewall administration, including security policy, NAT, zone design, application-aware filtering, and centralized management platforms Enterprise switching experience, including VLAN configuration, trunking, spanning tree, and QoS, in a production environment Microsoft 365 back-end administration: Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, licensing, and service health management Entra ID / Azure AD experience: Conditional Access, PIM, Identity Protection, automated provisioning, and group-based access management Windows Server administration: Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, GPO, and file services Familiarity with backup/DR concepts and tools; ability to design and verify recovery procedures PowerShell scripting for Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and Windows Server automation tasks Experience working in a compliance-driven environment (SOX, ITAR, HIPAA, PCI, or equivalent) Strong documentation discipline, you write things down and keep them current Preferred Qualifications Relevant firewall vendor certification (e.g., PCNSA/PCNSE or equivalent) Cisco CCNA or CCNP certification Microsoft certifications: MS-102 (M365 Administrator), SC-300 (Identity & Access), AZ-104 (Azure Administrator) Cloud-managed wireless and SD-WAN administration experience Modern endpoint management / zero-touch provisioning experience Vulnerability management platform experience Zero-trust / secure remote access administration experience Experience with storage networking and NAS platforms Experience supporting multi-site WAN environments Familiarity with enterprise ITSM platforms Compensation $90,000 – $105,000 Benefits Equity is included for all exempt positions Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits 401(k) Unlimited PTO Paid Holidays Daily Catered Lunches We are an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. review_candidates.description: About Komline As a pioneering leader in advanced separation technologies, Komline has established a global reputation for engineering excellence. Through our combination of innovative design, cutting-edge manufacturing capabilities, and decades of industry experience, we consistently deliver the highest quality equipment from our integrated manufacturing facilities. Serving our core markets of Water & Process, Agricultural & Renewables, and Industrials, we pride ourselves on providing comprehensive separation solutions precisely tailored to our clients' requirements. With a strong track record of strategic growth and acquisitions, Komline continues to expand its solution portfolio and technical capabilities while maintaining our commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction. This Senior Network Engineering opportunity is onsite in our beautiful Dupont Circle office in Washington. D.C. - 1250 Connecticut Avenue. This Opportunity The Senior Network Engineer is responsible for ensuring the reliability, security, and scalability of Komline’s networks across multiple site locations while leading integration efforts for newly acquired companies. Bringing hands-on technical expertise with a deep understanding of modern security frameworks in an enterprise setting, the Network Engineer will support Komline’s growth and evolution by assisting in the design and maintenance of the network infrastructure. Responsibilities Assess network, firewall, VPN, and wireless capabilities of acquired entities and develop integration plans to align with corporate standards Oversee LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, wireless, and VPN architectures to ensure high performance and availability Work with third-party MSPs to maintain enterprise firewalls, intrusion prevention systems, and access controls in collaboration with the Cybersecurity Lead Collaborate with system administrators to manage and integrate Active Directory environments across acquisitions. Ensure secure, efficient authentication, replication, and connectivity between domains and hybrid cloud services Identify opportunities to enhance network reliability, scalability, and security, including hardware and software upgrades Evaluate, select, and manage relationships with network equipment vendors, ISPs, and managed service providers Create & maintain detailed network diagrams, configurations, and standard operating procedures Develop & perform proactive monitoring, rapid incident response, and root-cause analysis for network-related issues Work closely with IT infrastructure, security, and cloud teams to ensure seamless connectivity and integration across all systems Contribute to annual budgeting, capacity planning, and long-term infrastructure roadmaps Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field 7+ years of experience managing enterprise networks in multi-site environments Experience integrating acquired networks or managing complex network transitions and upgrades Advanced knowledge of network technologies and principles (OSI model) Strong experience with firewalls, routing, switching, wireless, and network monitoring tools Knowledge of VMware/Hyper-V Virtualization technologies Familiarity with cloud service models and cloud integration with on-prem data center infrastructure Lead projects, manage timelines, and communicate effectively across teams. review_candidates.title: System Administrator
review_candidates.description: Exxel Pacific is seeking individuals who above all else desire joining, and being a key member of, an industry leading and dynamic company that is genuinely focused on its family of employees who, through working collaboratively together, create a thriving TEAM oriented culture. Job description As a member of the Exxel Pacific TEAM, the System Administrator is the first point of contact for supporting IT needs of employees. This position reports to and will work closely with the Director of IT to ensure consistency in procedures and assist employees in troubleshooting various issues. With 170 users and 25+ sites, we are looking to expand our IT staff. This position is full-time onsite at our Bellingham office, with regular onsite visits to jobsites generally in Whatcom County and the Greater Seattle area. Essential Functions General tier 2/3 user support, occasional tier 1 coverage. Server administration, management, configuration, maintenance, backups, and support across a hybrid on-premises and cloud environment. Network administration of switches, firewalls, VPNs, LANs/WLANs/VLANs, etc. Microsoft 365 and Exchange Online administration, including mail flow, security policies, and Exchange hybrid configuration. Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) administration, including identity/access management, MFA, and conditional access policies. Administration of email security/anti-spam and anti-phishing filtering, and multi-factor authentication (MFA) platforms. Endpoint management and mass software deployment via Microsoft Intune (or equivalent MDM), including patching and device compliance policies. Group policy and/or Intune configuration profile management. SQL Server administration, primarily backups and maintenance. Management, configuration, and maintenance of ESXi hosts and iSCSI SAN. Support of PBX/VOIP users, with an upcoming transition to Microsoft Teams Phone. Support of data backups, on-premises and cloud. Provide and receive cross-training with and from coworkers to build team-wide coverage and skill redundancy. Support end-user security awareness and phishing training programs, including monitoring and responding to reported incidents. There will be occasional work outside of regular business hours (almost always with prior planning) and shared on-call duties rotated among staff. 5+ years of experience supporting end users and administering Windows servers/networks and Microsoft 365 in a business environment. Relevant experience may substitute for a formal degree. Skills with SMB/SME network management, such as scripting/PowerShell, group policy and Intune configuration, documentation, automated monitoring tools, and trouble ticket systems. Previous MSP/consulting experience beneficial. Familiarity using/supporting these products/technologies: Windows 10/11 Pro, Windows Server 2019/2022, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams), Microsoft Intune, Enterprise Wifi, IP Telephony, Dell Latitude laptops, Microsoft Surface devices, iPads (used for specific line-of-business apps, not general use). CCNA/CCNP and current Microsoft role-based certifications (e.g., Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert, Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate, or Azure Administrator Associate) not required but beneficial; relevant experience may suffice. Must have reliable transportation, specifically able to get to jobsites and transport equipment. Additional specific products that would be beneficial to have experience with: Meraki firewall/VPN, VMware ESXi, Bluebeam Revu, Procore, Autodesk. The base salary range for this position is $37-$48 per hour, depending on qualifications and experience. Exxel Pacific offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance. Additional benefits include a 401k match, Short-Term Incentive Plan, Employee Stock Ownership Plan, Employee Assistance Program, and paid time off. Paid time off includes 8 paid holidays and 10-25 vacation days per year depending on years of service with Exxel.

review_candidates.title: System Administrator II
review_candidates.description: JOB SUMMARY: The System Administrator II provides advanced system administration, maintenance, and support for government clients within Trace3’s Federal, State, and Local practice. This role ensures the availability, performance, and security of IT infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments. The administrator will manage and troubleshoot systems, implement security controls, support compliance requirements, and collaborate with engineering and cybersecurity teams to sustain mission-critical operations. This position requires strong technical expertise, customer engagement skills, and the ability to work within regulated environments. SUMMARY OF ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS: Systems Administration & Maintenance Administer, configure, and maintain Windows and/or Linux servers in production, staging, and development environments. Perform advanced troubleshooting of system, network, and application issues. Monitor system performance, availability, and capacity; recommend and implement optimizations. Manage patching, updates, and server lifecycle tasks according to government security and compliance requirements. Infrastructure Operations Support Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, and identity management. Administer virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware vSphere/ESXi, Hyper-V). Manage storage systems, backup/recovery tools, and disaster recovery procedures. Support cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCC High) including provisioning, monitoring, and policy enforcement. Security & Compliance Implement and maintain security baselines, STIGs, IAVA updates, and hardening activities. Conduct vulnerability scanning, remediation, and documentation as required by client compliance frameworks. Assist with audit preparation and continuous monitoring under NIST, FedRAMP, CMMC, RMF, or agency-specific controls. Ensure proper logging, encryption, access controls, and incident response support. Operational Support Provide Tier II/III support for escalated service desk tickets and operational issues. Create and maintain system documentation, runbooks, and standard operating procedures. Support onboarding of new systems, services, and technologies. Collaborate with network engineering, cybersecurity, and cloud engineering teams to resolve cross-functional issues. Project & Customer Engagement Participate in technical planning and deployment of infrastructure improvement projects. Interface with government clients, program managers, and stakeholders to gather requirements and provide status updates. Evaluate and recommend new technologies, tools, and automation opportunities to improve environments. REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: Active (or active within 24 months) Secret clearance minimum - position can support upgrade to Top Secret (TS) or accept reciprocity from equivalent federal clearances. Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent experience preferred. 3–5 years of hands-on system administration experience supporting Windows and/or Linux environments. Experience supporting enterprise infrastructure (Active Directory, VMware, cloud services, storage, backups, etc.). Knowledge of cybersecurity practices, STIG/SCC tools, and vulnerability remediation. DoD 8570/8140 Baseline Certification (e.g., Security+, CCNA Security, CySA+, or equivalent). Experience supporting federal, state, local, or DoD client environments. Familiarity with RMF, NIST 800-53, CMMC, or FedRAMP compliance frameworks. Microsoft, VMware, AWS, or Azure technical certifications (MCSA/MCSE, VCP, AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Administrator, etc.). Experience with automation/scripting (PowerShell, Bash, Python). Experience with configuration management (Ansible, SCCM/MECM, Chef, or Puppet). PHYSICAL DEMANDS: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to: Remain in a stationary position for extended periods of time. Operate a computer, keyboard, and other office equipment using hands and fingers. Communicate effectively in person, over the phone, and through electronic means. Occasionally move about the office to access files, office equipment, and meeting spaces. Lift and/or move up to 15 pounds as needed. Maintain specific vision abilities, including close vision and the ability to adjust focus. WORK ENVIRONMENT: This position is performed within a secure, classified workspace . Employees must comply with all applicable security protocols and access control procedures, including restrictions on personal electronic devices and the handling of sensitive information. Close

review_candidates.title: Sr. Network Security Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Summary: We are seeking a Senior Network Security Engineer to lead the design, implementation, and maintenance of our enterprise Network Security infrastructure, with a heavy operational focus on Palo Alto Networks ecosystems and Zero Trust architectures. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in advancing our modern hybrid environment, ensuring robust protection, secure access, and aggressive threat mitigation. Key Responsibilities: Lead the design, implementation, and maintenance of network security solutions with a primary focus on Palo Alto firewalls (local and cloud appliances). Configure, manage, and troubleshoot Palo Alto firewalls using Panorama and Strata Cloud Manager, including advanced threat prevention capabilities (e.g., Enterprise DLP, Wildfire, URL Filtering, Global Protect VPN). Architect and deploy cloud implementations of Palo Alto technologies, specifically implementing Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW) within Azure Landing Zones to secure cloud and hybrid workloads. Design and implement Zero Trust network architectures, utilizing advanced network micro-segmentation strategies and tools to enforce strict access controls and significantly reduce lateral movement risk across the enterprise. Administer Cloudflare and Cisco Umbrella for secure edge access, DNS filtering, DDoS mitigation, WAF, API protections, and web proxy. Manage and maintain Public PKI certificate lifecycles to ensure secure encrypted communications and strong authentication. Lead vulnerability remediation efforts related to the network infrastructure and ensure timely closure. Participate in active incident response efforts involving network and perimeter security incidents. Participate in 24x7 support on-call rotation. Qualifications & Skills: 10-12 years of experience in enterprise network security engineering roles, with significant project leadership experience and prioritization and direction of contractors and junior staff. Bachelor’s degree in computer science, or related field. Deep proficiency and hands-on experience in Palo Alto Networks firewall configuration, troubleshooting, and advanced security features (Panorama, Strata, DLP, Global Protect). Founded in 1990, WWT brings together strategy, deep technical expertise and world-class partnerships to help public and private sector organizations design, build and scale intelligent AI, digital, cybersecurity, cloud and infrastructure solutions. What is the Infrastructure Services Team and why join? Infrastructure Services is a core WWT IT engineering team that builds, manages, and supports foundational server, virtualization, and operating system platforms. The Infrastructure Patch & Vulnerability Engineer is a mid-level technical role focused on strengthening infrastructure security posture through disciplined patching, vulnerability remediation, lifecycle management, and automation across Windows Server, Linux, VMware, and related enterprise infrastructure components. What will you be doing? In this role, you will help drive enterprise-wide patching and vulnerability management practices across the infrastructure estate, serving as a critical bridge between Information Security, Infrastructure Engineering, Operations, and application owner teams. Maintenance Coordination & Stakeholder Engagement: Work directly with application owners, infrastructure teams, Information Security, and vendors to coordinate maintenance windows, communicate patching impacts, resolve blockers, and align remediation plans with business and operational needs. Compliance Reporting & Governance: Develop and maintain patch compliance reporting, vulnerability remediation trackers, exception documentation, and recurring operational reviews to provide clear visibility into infrastructure risk, remediation progress, and areas requiring escalation. Operational Readiness & Documentation: Maintain technical runbooks, patch procedures, validation checklists, rollback plans, operational ticket queues, and knowledge documentation to support repeatable, auditable, and low-disruption infrastructure maintenance. , QUALIFICATIONS: Minimum Qualifications: Education & Experience: Associate degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field with 3+ years of hands-on system engineering experience; OR equivalent technical experience (5+ years in enterprise OS administration). Dual OS Expertise: Strong operational knowledge and administration experience with both Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) and Microsoft Windows Server in an enterprise environment. Provisioning & Azure Cloud: Hands-on experience provisioning and managing operating systems across both on-premises infrastructure and public cloud environments, specifically Microsoft Azure. Vulnerability & Patch Management: Hands-on experience executing enterprise patch management processes, interpreting vulnerability scan results, prioritizing remediation activity, and partnering with Information Security teams to reduce critical and high-risk infrastructure exposure. Automation & Scripting: Demonstrated proficiency writing automation scripts or infrastructure code using at least two of the following: PowerShell, Ansible, Terraform, or Python. Foundational IT Infrastructure: Solid working knowledge of core infrastructure primitives, including virtualization platforms such as VMware/vSphere, local and network storage configurations, TCP/IP networking, DNS, and Active Directory integration. Customer Service & Collaboration: Proven ability to support internal IT customer teams, communicate technical requirements clearly, and drive collaborative problem resolution. Preferred Qualifications: Multi-Cloud Experience: Experience provisioning and supporting operating system images across additional cloud providers, including Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Enterprise Tooling Experience: Hands-on experience utilizing enterprise-grade management, patching, virtualization lifecycle, and vulnerability tools such as Red Hat Satellite, Tanium, Tenable/Nessus, Microsoft management platforms, or VMware Lifecycle Manager. Process Improvement & Metrics: Proven track record of improving enterprise patch compliance, reducing vulnerability remediation backlogs, shortening patch cycle times, increasing automation coverage, or improving maintenance window predictability. AI Tooling Familiarity: Familiarity with AI-enabled tools, copilots, workflow assistants, or agentic automation platforms, with an interest in applying AI to infrastructure operations, patch planning, vulnerability analysis, documentation, reporting, and process optimization. Certifications: Relevant technical certifications validating OS, Cloud, or Automation skills, such as RHCSA, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator, or HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate. Enterprise Process Exposure: Familiarity with ITIL processes, formal change management, maintenance window scheduling, and incident management frameworks. About The Role The Senior Network Engineer will own the network architecture underpinning Torus Protect , the dedicated security technology deployed in every Torus Station and every Torus Site. Protect is built around a zero internet-facing attack surface, with all VPN tunnels outbound-initiated, and the network layer is the foundation that makes that model work in the field, at scale. This is a hands-on, deeply technical role for someone who thinks natively in routing, switching, and segmentation, and who can carry that expertise from lab design through fielded, multi-site production deployments. You'll lead the ongoing Meraki-to-Catalyst migration and IOx containerization effort, own the VLAN and segmentation model across protect's control and OT planes, and be the final technical authority on network design decisions that touch security, reliability, and compliance. Advance IOx Containerization — Own the technical gating for containerized workloads hosted on switch/router IOx application hosting, including kernel-level EDR compatibility, access requirements, and persistent state volume design. Design & Harden the Tailscale Mesh — Own the mesh VPN architecture connecting Security Routers across sites, including HA subnet router design, dual-route advertisement, and ACL scoping. Own VLAN & Segmentation Strategy — Maintain and evolve the VLAN architecture spanning Security Router, Maintenance, BESS, and FESS/PLC segments, ensuring appropriate isolation and documented compensating controls where standard agents cannot run. Validate Redundancy & Failover — Design and test failover paths across dual-NIC Security Routers, redundant switching, and VPN tunnels, with particular attention to segments relying on VPN ACL and segmentation as primary compensating controls. Partner on Security Architecture — Work closely with the security architecture team to ensure network design decisions align with protect's broader threat model, EDR/MDM requirements, and compliance posture (IEC 62443, NERC CIP, CMMC Level 2). Troubleshoot Fielded Networks — Serve as the escalation point for complex network issues across deployed Torus Stations, using packet capture and protocol analysis (including OT protocols) to diagnose and resolve field incidents. Document & Mentor — Produce clear reference architecture documentation and runbooks, and mentor other engineers on network design principles specific to protect's constraints. Cross-Functional Partnership — Collaborate with hardware procurement, firmware, security, and product teams to ensure network design keeps pace with new Station product lines and evolving compliance requirements. Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking English required. When on the production floor, required to don personal protective equipment to include, but not limited to ear protection, gloves, eye protection and/or safety helmet. A time to step back, think strategically, and work on the business together. Team members receive Torus branded gear Peer Recognition Program Fully stocked break rooms with free snacks and drinks. US citizenship and an active TS/SCI with FSP security clearance required. One (1) year experience integrating ServiceNow with other applications is required. ServiceNow System Administrator certification is required. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium’s mission is to deliver results for our investors. Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact. Meet the Team The Developer Services team architects, engineers, and enhances developer toolchains and workflows for the firm. We collaborate closely with developers, quants, researchers, and front-office trading teams to ensure our platform provides a best-in-class development experience. What You'll Do We're looking for a Cloud Platform / Infrastructure Engineer to design, build, and operate cloud-native infrastructure that enables teams across the firm to deploy workloads safely and reliably at scale. Design cloud-native architecture solutions grounded in the pillars of the AWS Well-Architected Framework: Operational Excellence, Security, Reliability, Performance Efficiency, and Cost Optimization Build CI/CD pipelines for reliable deployments Establish infrastructure-as-code practices that make our systems reproducible and auditable Work closely with software engineers to ensure our cloud platforms are secure, scalable, and operationally excellent Use AI and other automation to increase teams’ visibility into their cloud costs and migration onto strategic infrastructure Help teams understand risks and plan for proper business continuity Beyond immediate delivery, you'll help define platform infrastructure best practices that scale across the firm's broader cloud-native footprint What You Bring Strong AWS expertise - VPC architecture, IAM, EC2, S3, ECS/EKS, networking, and data lake architectures Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, including designing container architectures for multi-tenant workloads Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills, with Python and/or Bash for tooling and automation Proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, plus GitOps workflows and CI/CD platforms (ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, Jenkins) Proficiency with Observability tooling similar to Datadog/Prometheus/Grafana Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, with 3+ years (or a Master's degree with 2 years) in a cloud/infrastructure/DevOps engineering role Technical leadership - ability to drive architectural decisions and mentor others, with strong communication and problem-solving skills A desire to deliver cutting edge infrastructure in a fast-moving environment, with a commitment to staying current on cloud-native infrastructure, container security, and workload deployment Salary Range Millennium offers a total compensation package which includes a base salary, discretionary performance bonus, and comprehensive benefits. The estimated base salary range for this position is $175,000 to $250,000, which is specific to New York and may change in the future. When finalizing an offer, we take into consideration an individual's experience level and the qualifications they bring to the role to formulate a competitive total compensation package.

Experience in current Internet network hardware and software technologies. Diagnostic experience of a variety of monitoring applications such as SolarWinds, Nagios BENEFITS: We truly appreciate and value all our employees and show our appreciation by offering a wide range of benefits, including: Comprehensive Healthcare/Dental/Vision Plans 401K Retirement Plan with Company Match Paid Vacation, Sick Time, and Additional Holidays (including your Birthday!) review_candidates.title: Lead AI Infrastructure Operations Engineer
review_candidates.description: Department Information Technology Job Description The Lead AI Infrastructure Operations Engineer is responsible for enabling, operating, and continuously improving the infrastructure and operational capabilities required by production AI solutions. As TMG expands its AI capabilities, AI CoE will develop large language model, retrieval-augmented generation, agent-based, machine-learning, and other AI-enabled use cases. This role will work within the Infrastructure team to help those teams define and coordinate their infrastructure, environment, connectivity, observability, security, capacity, and production-readiness needs. The engineer in collaboration with other Infrastructure resources will focus on the AI application, platform, and operational layers. TMG’s managed services provider operates the underlying AWS cloud infrastructure. This role will translate AI solution requirements, coordinate infrastructure services and changes, monitor delivery, diagnose issues, and validate that environments meet reliability, security, performance, and operational expectations. This is a hands-on role that works closely with AI engineering, application development, data, architecture, cybersecurity, infrastructure operations, and external managed-services partners. Work Arrangement Employees who live within 30 miles of the TMG home office are expected to follow a hybrid or in-office schedule. The initial training period may require additional in‑office days. Accountabilities Enable AI Infrastructure and Environments Partner with AI engineering, application, data, security, architecture, and platform teams to understand the infrastructure and operational needs of new AI use cases. Translate AI solution designs into requirements for environments, compute, storage, networking, connectivity, identity, security, observability, capacity, and supporting cloud services. In Collaboration with other Infrastructure resources and managed service provider, coordinate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, access, and changes with TMG’s AWS managed-services provider and other technology partners. Support operational readiness for AI solutions transitioning into production. Identify infrastructure dependencies, constraints, risks, costs, and lead times early in the delivery lifecycle. Establish reusable infrastructure patterns, operational standards, dashboards, runbooks, and production-readiness requirements across AI use cases. Validate that environments and supporting services are appropriately configured, monitored, secured, scalable, and ready for production use. Implement new cloud functionality requirements in collaboration with architecture and AI engineering within approved architecture and guardrails. Follow and enforce established security, compliance, and operational controls across AI platforms and infrastructure. Operate and Improve Production AI Solutions Work with managed services to Implement and maintain observability, logging, tracing, monitoring, dashboards, and alerting for production AI applications. Define and track operational metrics covering AI quality, reliability, latency, cost, utilization, adoption, and business outcomes. Work with AI engineering team to diagnose production issues across AI applications, models, prompts, retrieval systems, data, integrations, and supporting infrastructure. Support root-cause analysis and coordinate resolution with AI engineers, application teams, platform teams, and managed-services providers. Support AI-related incident management, problem management, operational reviews, release validation, and production-readiness activities. Create and maintain service-health dashboards, runbooks, troubleshooting guidance, support procedures, and escalation paths. Define and track service health indicators, SLIs, SLOs, and operational KPIs for production AI solutions. Use telemetry, evaluations, and production data to validate fixes, releases, configuration changes, and system improvements. Support AI Risk and Operational Governance Partner with AI and IT governance team to operationalize applicable controls and monitoring requirements. Operationalize evaluation processes and support AI Governance team to monitor AI performance, regressions, drift, grounding, retrieval quality, and overall effectiveness. Support the collection and retention of operational evidence, including model and prompt versions, evaluation results, incidents, exceptions, and corrective actions. Identify material changes in AI behavior and help ensure they are evaluated, documented, and appropriately addressed. Analyze trends and proactively identify degradation, drift, capacity constraints, reliability risks, and quality issues before they become production incidents Key Outcomes AI teams receive timely and consistent infrastructure and operational support. AI use cases move efficiently from experimentation to reliable production operation. Reusable infrastructure and operational patterns are applied across AI initiatives. End-to-end visibility exists across AI applications and supporting services. AI quality, reliability, cost, usage, and business impact are consistently measured. Production issues are detected, diagnosed, and resolved more quickly. Releases result in fewer regressions and operational disruptions. Secure, compliant, and audit-ready AI platforms meeting enterprise governance and risk requirements Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 8+ years of overall information technology experience, including 5+ years in infrastructure operations, cloud operations, site reliability engineering, DevOps, platform operations, application operations, or production engineering. Experience supporting cloud-hosted, distributed, data-intensive, or AI-enabled production applications. Experience implementing and supporting observability, logging, tracing, monitoring, dashboards, alerting, and operational reporting. Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure, networking, APIs, integrations, identity and access management, security, and data pipelines. Experience coordinating infrastructure services, changes, dependencies, and issue resolution across internal teams, technology partners, and managed-services providers. Familiarity with AWS services and capabilities related to monitoring, logging, networking, security, identity, and infrastructure operations. Experience with automation, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, and release-management practices. Experience operating or supporting LLM, generative AI, machine-learning, RAG, or agent-based applications in production is strongly preferred. Familiarity with AI observability, evaluation, model monitoring, hallucination detection, grounding, retrieval quality, model or data drift, and prompt-related risks. Familiarity with vector databases, model APIs, AI gateways, prompt-management platforms, or agent orchestration frameworks. Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities across concurrent technology initiatives. Experience in insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry, along with relevant AWS, cloud, infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, security, or AI certifications, is preferred. Pay Range Anticipated Hiring Range: $130,000 - $150,000 annual base salary depending on experience, qualifications, and geographic location Benefits We are proud to offer our full-time regular employees a robust benefits suite that includes: Competitive base salary plus incentive plans for eligible team members 401(K) retirement plan that includes a company match of up to 6% of your eligible salary Free basic life and AD&D, long-term disability and short-term disability insurance Medical, dental and vision plans to meet your unique healthcare needs Wellness incentives Generous time off program that includes personal, holiday and volunteer paid time off Flexible work schedules and hybrid/remote options for eligible positions Educational assistance Equal Opportunity Employer The Mutual Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is our policy to recruit, hire, train and promote individuals in all job classifications without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law. Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal Your Rights Under USERRA Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation due to a disability at any stage of the employment application process should contact Talent@themutualgroup.com . Employment Verification The Mutual Group participates in the E-Verify program and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. You are protected from employment discrimination based on your citizenship status and national origin. E-Verify Program Overview E-Verify Participation Poster All offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check. #TMG

networking, security, and platform standards Drive Azure Well-Architected Framework reviews and engineering best practices Build enterprise Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and Azure DevOps engineering Mentor engineers, lead architecture reviews, and define enterprise cloud strategy What You'll Bring Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent experience (or equivalent practical experience). 10+ years designing enterprise cloud infrastructure 7+ years designing and operating Microsoft Azure platforms Proven experience delivering Azure Landing Zones, governance, networking, identity, and security at enterprise scale Deep expertise across Azure compute, networking, storage, monitoring, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), Azure DevOps, and CI/CD Experience with Azure Well-Architected Framework, FinOps, disaster recovery, and platform reliability Strong technical leadership with experience influencing architecture across engineering teams Nice Help shape the future of modern, AI-enabled cloud platform powering enterprise-scale operations. review_candidates.title: [IT Customer Engineer] Tool Computing & Server Infrastructure for PDC
review_candidates.description: Who We Are Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. What We Offer Location: Icheon-Godam,KOR You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits. As a Field Service Engineer [Customer Engineer] at Applied Materials, you serve as the direct liaison with customers, collaborating closely to install, maintain, and upgrade equipment. You'll use digital analytics for troubleshooting and apply basic diagnostic techniques to assess and address technical issues. Your responsibilities include performing preventative and corrective maintenance on various systems such as electrical, vacuum, mechanical, plasma, hydraulic, and gas systems. Additionally, you'll coordinate and communicate directly with customers to ensure smooth operations and exceptional service. Key Responsibilities Tool Computing Systems Support Troubleshoot and resolve computing infrastructure issues impacting semiconductor manufacturing equipment. Respond to and recover from system incidents affecting tool operations. Support the stable operation of customer production environments. Collaborate with internal technical teams and external vendors to resolve complex technical issues. Server & Infrastructure Operations Operate and maintain enterprise IT infrastructure environments. Administer virtualization, container platforms, storage, and network systems. Perform system monitoring and preventive maintenance activities. Support hardware replacement, server recovery, and system restoration. Assist with new system deployment, installation, and upgrade projects. Technical Support & Continuous Improvement Conduct root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions. Provide technical support and guidance to engineering teams. review_candidates.title: Senior Storage Engineer - Everpure FlashBlade and FlashArray
review_candidates.description: CMK Resources is seeking a Senior Pure Storage Resident Engineer to support one of our strategic technology partners and their end customer, a major financial services organization. This is a highly visible, hands-on engineering role supporting a large and complex enterprise storage environment across Pure Storage FlashBlade and FlashArray. We are specifically looking for an engineer with strong, hands-on production experience with BOTH Pure Storage FlashBlade and FlashArray. Candidates must have personally administered, supported, optimized, and troubleshot both platforms in enterprise environments. This is not an architecture-only, implementation-only, or pre-sales position. The ideal candidate is a senior operational storage engineer with deep expertise across file, object, and block storage, including S3, and the troubleshooting skills to independently own complex production issues. This is also a true Resident Engineer position. You will work directly alongside the customer, take ownership of technical issues and optimization initiatives, and become a trusted technical advisor within their storage organization. What You Will Be Doing Provide hands-on administration, operational support, troubleshooting, and optimization of Pure Storage FlashBlade and FlashArray in a large enterprise production environment. Troubleshoot complex storage issues involving performance, latency, availability, capacity, connectivity, access, and application workloads. Support S3/object storage environments, including APIs, buckets, authentication, permissions, performance, and application connectivity. Administer and troubleshoot enterprise file services, including NFS and SMB/CIFS. Support enterprise block storage workloads on Pure FlashArray, including SAN connectivity and performance. Perform proactive health checks, performance analysis, capacity planning, monitoring, and optimization across the Pure environment. Support multi-tenant environments, including RBAC, access policies, authentication, and tenant separation. Manage and troubleshoot snapshots, replication, data protection, high availability, and disaster recovery. Support upgrades, maintenance activities, infrastructure changes, migrations, and lifecycle management. Perform deep root cause analysis using logs, metrics, alerts, and system behavior rather than relying solely on vendor escalation. Work across storage, VMware, Linux, networking, backup, security, database, cloud, and application teams to resolve complex infrastructure issues. Participate in incident management, change management, maintenance windows, and major production events. Identify opportunities to improve storage performance, reliability, utilization, and operational efficiency. Develop and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, runbooks, and best practices. Serve as a trusted technical advisor to the customer, proactively identifying risks and recommending improvements. What You Bring to the Role 8+ years of enterprise storage engineering experience supporting large, business-critical production environments. Hands-on Pure Storage FlashBlade experience is required. Hands-on Pure Storage FlashArray experience is required. Demonstrated experience administering and troubleshooting both FlashBlade and FlashArray in production environments. Strong hands-on experience across file, object, and block storage. Strong knowledge of S3/object storage, including troubleshooting workloads, APIs, access, permissions, and performance. Strong experience with NFS and SMB/CIFS. Strong understanding of enterprise SAN/block storage concepts and troubleshooting. Experience troubleshooting storage performance, latency, capacity, availability, connectivity, and access issues. Experience with storage monitoring, observability, health checks, capacity planning, and performance optimization. Understanding of multi-tenancy, RBAC, access policies, authentication, and security within enterprise storage environments. Experience with snapshots, replication, high availability, disaster recovery, and data protection. Experience supporting large-scale enterprise environments, ideally at the petabyte scale. Experience with VMware and enterprise virtualized environments. Strong Linux troubleshooting skills and the ability to investigate issues across storage, host, network, and application layers. Experience operating within formal enterprise incident, change, and problem management processes. Customer-Facing Experience Technical expertise alone will not be enough for this position. The successful candidate must be comfortable operating as a Resident Engineer and trusted technical advisor within a large enterprise customer. You should have experience: Working directly with enterprise customers or internal infrastructure stakeholders. Taking ownership of complex technical issues from initial investigation through resolution. Leading technical troubleshooting and root cause analysis discussions. Communicating effectively during high-severity production incidents. Providing proactive recommendations rather than operating solely in a reactive support capacity. Presenting technical risks, findings, and best practices to customer stakeholders. Building credibility and long-term relationships with engineering teams. Working independently while effectively engaging vendor engineering and support resources when necessary.

Shift: TBD, but must be flexible for all shifts. Documents incident status and solutions in incident database tools. In addition, the Tier 1 Analyst will support service and change requests for a highly critical and dynamic WAN/LAN/MAN environment. Experience using network monitoring and performance management tools such as Riverbed, IBM Netcool, Splunk, SolarWinds, or similar platforms. Knowledge of ITIL processes, including incident, problem, and change management. Details Target Salary Range: $51,000 - $82,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. review_candidates.title: Senior Network Reliability Engineer, Incident Management
review_candidates.description: The world still has coverage blind spots. You could help eliminate them at Skylo. Skylo has pioneered a standards-based approach to satellite connectivity. We connect smartphones and IoT devices directly to satellites. No special hardware, no entirely new networks. Just billions of existing devices, suddenly reachable anywhere on Earth. We're not building toward this future. We're already in it. Our direct-to-device service is live on millions of activated devices across five continents, covering more than 72 million square kilometers, in partnership with leading satellite operators, mobile network operators, Tier-1 chipset makers, and OEMs worldwide. And we're just getting started. At the heart of it all is Skylo's commercial NTN vRAN: a 3GPP standards-based, cloud-native platform that seamlessly bridges terrestrial and satellite networks. It's the infrastructure that makes true anywhere, anytime connectivity possible. When you join Skylo, you'll work at the intersection of three markets reshaping how the world stays connected: mass-market consumer devices, automotive, and industrial IoT. Enabling people outdoors and critical workflows in the world's most remote places. This is a rare chance to work on technology that matters, at a company that's already proving it works How You Will Impact Skylo As a Network Reliability Engineer (NRE) for Incident Management in the Global Product Support & Customer Success organization, you are the operational nerve center of Skylo's 24x7 incident response function. You own the bridge, from first alert to full-service restoration. On a network where every subscriber is roaming over satellite, structured incident coordination directly determines whether millions of devices stay connected. You operate across all three Skylo hubs (Mountain View, Espoo, Bengaluru) and across every network domain: RAN, 5G Core, Cloud Infrastructure, and OSS, ensuring incidents are triaged, escalated, and resolved with speed and discipline. At Senior NRE level you independently command bridge calls for Sev 1-4 incidents, support subject matter experts as incident coordinator and function as the communication lead during Sev 1 events, drive the execution of runbooks without supervision, manage the full incident lifecycle end-to-end in the ticketing system, and continuously improve the procedures you operate against. You are not a ticket router, you are the structured coordinator who ensures every incident has a clear owner, a live timeline, and a documented resolution path. Assuring Skylo's network availability commitments to MNO partners and meeting SLA obligations is your primary measure of success. Key Responsibilities Incident Command & Bridge Coordination Serve as the central command point during all network degradations, service disruptions, and subscriber-impacting events, opening the bridge, initiating the incident management process, and maintaining command from first alert through full-service restoration. Own end-to-end incident lifecycle management for Sev 1-4: initiate bridge calls, identify the cause and impacted domain, page the correct on-call NRE, maintain bridge discipline with clear ownership and timelines, and drive to restoration. Prioritize incidents according to urgency and business impact, classifying severity accurately using alarm signatures, subscriber impact data, and domain KPI telemetry from available OSS systems. Escalate to subject matter experts in Operations and Engineering teams when critical or time-sensitive resolution is required, providing full technical context, a structured problem statement, and a documented timeline. Engage and interface with vendor support teams (RAN vendor, Core vendor, cloud infrastructure) when incident resolution requires external escalation; track vendor SLA response and escalate vendor delays to the domain NRE. Support hypercare operations during major network launches, high-risk change windows, and special events, maintaining readiness and acting as first responder for any degradation during the hypercare window. Incident Documentation & Lifecycle Management Ensure all trouble tickets are created promptly in the incident management system (Jira/ServiceNow) with complete technical details, troubleshooting steps, MOPs followed, and outcome documentation, never closing an incident with an incomplete ticket. Produce a structured incident timeline artifact within two hours of closure: sequence of events, alarms triggered, actions taken, bridge participants, and all open action items with assigned owners and due dates. Manage the open incident backlog at optimum levels: track ageing tickets, escalate stalled items, and ensure no incident closes without a documented resolution path or a justified deferral. Coordinate post-incident review (PIR) scheduling: compile the incident record, gather logs from in-house observability tools and other relevant sources, and deliver a structured problem statement to the domain NREs owning the root cause analysis. Handle internal, external, and MNO partner incident escalations and follow-ups; interface with Market Operations, OEM contacts, and partner NOCs for joint incident resolution, ensuring external-facing communications are approved before transmission. Network Availability & SLA Assurance Assure that Skylo's operated network meets agreed availability KPIs and MNO partner SLA commitments, proactively tracking availability metrics and flagging degradation trends before they breach SLA thresholds. Track top recurring issues and feed continuous improvement inputs: document repeat-incident patterns, identify the operational gap (missing runbook, stale threshold, absent alert), and route findings to the appropriate domain NRE for action. Contribute to the weekly and monthly Network Performance Report: incident count by severity and domain, MTTR trends, top issues, SLA compliance summary, and KPI deviation analysis. Drive proactive measures for network issue detection and isolation, actively participating in the Service Assurance and Automation domain and providing operational input for closed-loop automation requirements. On-Call & Shift Operations Participate in the global follow-the-sun on-call rotation as the incident coordination tier: Espoo shift bridges the US overnight window, while Mountain View and Bengaluru shifts cover their respective regions, maintaining 24x7 continuous coverage. Maintain shift handoff hygiene: produce a written end-of-shift summary covering open incidents, degraded components, active change windows, vendor escalations in flight, and priority items for the incoming shift. Manage the on-call paging workflow: acknowledge alerts within SLA target windows, escalate to L2 within defined thresholds, and ensure no alert goes unacknowledged across the shift boundary. Support planned maintenance and change windows: validate pre-change observability coverage, confirm rollback readiness with the NI team, and execute rollback runbooks if a deployment causes service degradation. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work in close collaboration across multiple Skylo functions during incidents: RAN NRE, Core NRE, Cloud Infrastructure NRE, BOSS (BSS & OSS), Network Implementation, Product Engineering and Market teams, coordinating without creating confusion by maintaining a single source of truth on the bridge. Engage appropriate stakeholders based on incident signature, subscriber impact, and domain ownership, avoiding over-escalation and under-escalation with disciplined severity classification. Interface with MNO partner NOC teams during shared-impact events: relay technical status updates, manage the partner communication cadence, and escalate partner requests through the correct internal channel. Surface repetitive manual incident steps to the service assurance automation team, documenting the step, frequency, and toil cost as structured input to the automation backlog. Technical Domain Knowledge Maintain working knowledge of RAN architecture relevant to incident triage: CUSM (Control plane, User plane, Synchronization plane, Management plane), eCPRI/CPRI interfaces, PTP and SyncE timing, Netconf, and NTN-specific RAN alarm patterns. Understand 5G Core network function roles (AMF, SMF, UPF, NRF, PCF, SEPP) at a level sufficient to classify an alarm, identify subscriber impact, and escalate with technical context. Operate virtualized NTN infrastructure observability tools: navigate Grafana dashboards, learn and use custom in-house tooling capabilities, run kubectl commands to assess pod health, and correlate OSS alarms with underlying infrastructure events. Build domain depth progressively across the first 12 months; the Senior NRE role is a structured development track toward Staff NRE and Principal NRE, where independent incident command and domain ownership are the primary accountabilities. Qualifications Required 5-10+ years of experience in telecom/wireless operations, network operations, or NRE in a production 24x7 environment. Demonstrated ability to independently manage incident bridge calls: open the war room, maintain bridge discipline, drive to resolution, and produce a structured incident record. Strong understanding of telecom network environments and 5G functional components, with sufficient knowledge of RAN (CUSM, eCPRI, PTP/SyncE), 5G Core (AMF, SMF, UPF), and Cloud/OSS to triage intelligently and escalate with context. Incident and outage management expertise: ability to prioritize by urgency and impact, manage multiple simultaneous events, and operate effectively under high-pressure 24x7 conditions. Hands-on experience with at least one observability platform: Grafana dashboards, Prometheus alerting, Loki log queries, or equivalent, with the ability to independently navigate to relevant signals during an active incident. Kubernetes operational literacy: able to run kubectl get pods, describe a failing pod, read container logs, and identify health issues at the level needed to triage and escalate a platform-layer incident. Structured written communication: capable of producing clear incident timelines, executive stakeholder updates, and post-incident summaries under time pressure. Ticketing system proficiency (Jira, ServiceNow, or equivalent): incident lifecycle management, escalation workflows, and backlog hygiene. On-call tooling experience (PagerDuty or equivalent): alert acknowledgement, escalation policy management, and on-call scheduling. Ability to span departments and build strong working relationships with RAN, Core, Cloud, Engineering, and external partner teams to drive joint incident resolution. Preferred Prior experience in a satellite, NTN, or space-to-ground connectivity operational environment. Experience with OSS/BSS platforms: FCAPS alarm management, event correlation, SNMP trap handling, or EMS integration. Familiarity with 3GPP NAS/NG-AP signaling flows, RRC state machine, or IMSI lifecycle procedures. ITIL Foundation certification or demonstrated practical application of ITIL incident, problem, and change management processes. Scripting ability in Python or Bash, sufficient to automate repetitive operational tasks, parse log output, or build quick diagnostic utilities. Experience supporting hypercare operations, major network launches, or high-risk change windows. Exposure to closed-loop automation frameworks or service assurance platforms used in network operations. What We Offer With employees working across three continents, Skylo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. Our worldwide culture encourages a flexible approach to work, and we offer an attractive range of benefits: Competitive compensation packages including a stock option-based equity program Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, and retirement plan Monthly allowances for wellness and education reimbursement A generous time-off policy, holidays, and the opportunity to temporarily work abroad A once-in-a-career opportunity to operate the world's first commercial, live direct-to-device satellite network Access to a world-class team across software, hardware, chipsets, telecom, satellite, and network virtualization Open, transparent, inclusive culture that blends Silicon Valley, Nordic, and South Asia characteristics Additional Information The compensation ranges for this position is: Remote, U.S: $125,000 – $135,000 base salary + equity These ranges reflects the low and high end of the range Skylo reasonably and generally expects to pay the hired candidate in this role. EEO STATEMENT Skylo is an equal-opportunity employer and we celebrate diversity. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. Please let us know if you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability.

review_candidates.title: Sr. Consultant, I&O Operations
review_candidates.description: Cargill is committed to providing food and agricultural solutions to nourish the world in a safe, responsible, and sustainable way. Sitting at the heart of the supply chain, we partner with farmers and customers to source, make and deliver products that are vital for living. Our 155,000 team members innovate with purpose, providing customers with life’s essentials so businesses can grow, communities prosper, and consumers live well. With over 160 years of experience as a family company, we look ahead while remaining true to our values. We put people first. We reach higher. We do the right thing—today and for generations to come. Job Purpose and Impact The Senior Professional, Operations job maintains the smooth operation of the organization's infrastructure by performing complex tasks, including monitoring systems, troubleshooting issues, and implementing security measures. With minimal supervision, this job serves as a trusted onsite IT partner physically based within manufacturing facilities, providing hands-on support for infrastructure and workplace technology. The role may support multiple facilities within an assigned geographic territory and may require travel to nearby sites. This job collaborates with vendors and internal teams to document and resolve complex network and infrastructure issues, maintain technology asset inventories, and implement solutions that improve reliability, availability, and security across plant environments. Key Accountabilities MONITORING INFRASTRUCTURE PERFORMANCE: Leads performance monitoring of network, virtual, and physical devices to maintain smooth and efficient operations, applying tools to track network traffic, identify issues, and ensure optimal performance. TROUBLESHOOTING & RESOLVING ISSUES: Diagnoses and resolves complex infrastructure and workplace technology problems affecting routers, switches, servers, communication circuits, PCs, scanners, printers, and other site technology assets, including performing root cause analysis and implementing solutions to prevent future occurrences. INCIDENT MANAGEMENT: Leads monitoring and responding to network and hosting incidents, outages, performance alerts, and production-impacting technology issues including categorizing issues, and facilitating with technical teams for timely resolution. PROTOCOL ANALYSIS: Performs complex protocol analysis to troubleshoot network issues and sustain proper communication between network devices. CONFIGURATION & DEPLOYMENT: Configures and deploys new hardware and software while ensuring compatibility with existing systems, including setting up servers, network devices, and other infrastructure components. COLLABORATION & COMMUNICATION: Partners with vendors, third party service providers, remote technology teams, and internal teams to execute onsite technology work, resolve complex issues and improve performance, providing effective and efficient communication, coordination and timely updates. DOCUMENTATION & REPORTING: Validates the documentation of network and infrastructure issues, resolutions, performance trends, and technology asset inventories; reviews and provides reports to stakeholders to inform decision making and improve operational performance. BACKUP & DISASTER RECOVERY: Develops and maintains backup and disaster recovery plans to ensure data integrity and availability in case of system failures or data loss. PROJECT MANAGEMENT: Leads information technology projects, such as system upgrades, migrations, and new implementations, delivering projects on time and within budget. AUTOMATION & SCRIPTING: Develops automation scripts and tools to streamline infrastructure management tasks and improve operational efficiency. Qualifications Minimum requirement of 4 years of relevant work experience. Typically reflects 5 years or more of relevant experience. Equal Opportunity Employer, including Disability/Vet. To apply using chat/text, please click Apply Now button OR use this link to create a login to apply.

review_candidates.description: Hybrid with travel to Bath, London and Edinburgh a couple times a month About Us Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well. We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe. We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale. We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand. If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company. Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments. The role We're looking for a Platform engineer to shape and evolve the platform that underpins our investment products. You’ll be someone who loves understanding engineering problems and enabling teams to self-serve their needs. You view the cloud platform as a product, and engineering as your customer. The role is within our Cloud Resilience team - a critical squad within our engineering organisation responsible for empowering squads to build and run their own services. We’re primarily in AWS , utilising Lambda, ECS, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway, Aurora, Redshift among others. Our main data store is MongoDB Atlas and our observability platform is Datadog . Our application is written in Typescript/NodeJS and our infrastructure is defined in Terraform . On a typical day you will be… Architecting, implementing, and maintaining scalable, secure infrastructure in AWS using Terraform. Designing cloud-native solutions using MongoDB, Lambda, API Gateway, and other AWS services with a strong focus on serverless. Contributing to incident response efforts, production readiness, and reliability initiatives across engineering squads. Enhancing observability and platform insight through actionable alerting and data visibility using Datadog. Continuously improving CI/CD processes with GitHub Actions, reducing friction in delivery pipelines. Collaborating with software engineers (working in Node.js/TypeScript) to ensure secure, performant, and resilient applications. Mentoring engineers and champion DevOps culture and best practices across teams. This role’s for you if... You’re a pragmatic platform engineer with experience in regulated environments, balancing delivery with compliance and operational excellence. You’re confident working with JavaScript/TypeScript-based applications and collaborating closely with development teams. You know what “good” looks like for databases like MongoDB and Postgres and can diagnose, design, and optimise for scale and resilience. You care deeply about observability - you don’t just monitor systems, you build alerts that engineers can act on. You’re fluent in AWS best practices, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), and CI/CD tooling like GitHub Actions. You’ve had exposure to architectural decisions and willingness to own of platform-level outcomes. This role isn’t for you if... You rely on a lot of top-down direction. Here, you’ll have a lot of freedom and ownership of your role, and you’ll be expected to shape your own progression You’re not comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Our speed and scalability are what set us apart; you need to be able to act quickly and think on your feet You struggle to follow through on ideas. We value people who do what they say they will. If you care about something, you have the freedom here to make it happen You don’t like change. You’ll get on great here if you relish the ambiguity of rapid growth and are willing to embrace uncertainty What’s In It For You… We offer a generous mix of benefits for the things that really matter to our people, including: 💰 A salary between £55,000 and £75,000 – dependant on experience + reviewed annually 🌴 27 days holiday + bank holidays (some can be flexible) + day off on your birthday + three days (full time) per year for Dependant leave 💙 Two volunteering days per year 🌎 Option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year 🌟 Secclbrate - our recognition programme that offers a mix of flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget 🏅 Length of service award – one month paid sabbatical at eight years ✅ 6% employer pension contribution, and life assurance 🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health 👪 Enhanced Parental leave 💻 MacBook and up to £500 home office set up budget 📖 £750 per person learning budget 🌻 Health and wellbeing initiatives including free therapy via Wellness Cloud, mental health support via Headspace 🌱 Strong financial wellbeing focus including access to Octopus Money, Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing offering via Octopus Legacy 🎁 Perkbox – Flexi-points giving you a range of discounts and perks including free weekly coffee, gym and retail discounts 🚲 Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing Our culture We're proud to put people first, creating a culture where we truly listen to what matters most to them. Our transparent and inclusive environment encourages diversity of thought, challenge and experimentation. Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team. Interview process Interviewing Is a Two-way Thing, And We Want You To Have The Time And Opportunity To Get To Know Us, As Much As We Are Getting To Know You. Our Interviews Are Conversational, So Come With Questions And Be Curious. In General, You Can Expect The Interview Process To Look a Bit Like This, (following An Initial Chat With One Of Our Talent Team) First stage – 60 mins Cloud System Design interview Second stage – 60 mins Terraform Code Review Interview Final stage – 45 mins bar-raiser culture-based interview ⏳ We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out and you should expect to hear back from us within one to two weeks of applying. 🌈 Our aim is to build a diverse and inclusive company of awesome people, with unique skills, passions and experiences. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status. If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you! Compensation Range: £55K - £75K
